# Touched on the Ridges

*Some of the ridges' stumps are Disturbance-touched: bigger, harder and shimmering. Skarra pays well for each one put down.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md) |
| Level | 22 |
| After | [Red Dots](../quests/skarra_red_dots.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 1 Elite Disturbance-touched stump ([Gnarled Stump](../monsters/gnarled_stump.md), [Axe Stump](../monsters/axe_stump.md), [Dark Axe Stump](../monsters/dark_axe_stump.md))

## Rewards

- 1,800 EXP
- 440 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 3,000 EXP, 880 mesos, [Elixir](../items/elixir.md) x5, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Skarra](../npcs/skarra_uskari.md)
